description:
We're kicking off the year with a video that we're hoping might just be colourful enough to wash away a layer of that cold January grey. Wroth - a recent release from Chip Theory Games is simple, tactile, a just a little bit CHUNKY. We hope you've all had a restful end to 2025 - and wish you all the best in the year to come!
